summary: With a strong foundation in React.js and Node.js, you possess the highly sought-after JavaScript/TypeScript full-stack skill set. You are perfectly positioned to excel as a Full Stack JavaScript Developer, capable of building seamless, high-performance web applications from user interface to database integration.

jobOptions.title: Full Stack Developer
jobOptions.responsibilities: Design and build interactive user interfaces using React, develop robust backend RESTful or GraphQL APIs using Node.js, manage data flow, and ensure seamless integration between the front-end and back-end systems.
jobOptions.why: Your current stack covers the entire client-server architecture of modern web applications, making you a versatile asset who can own features from end to end.

jobOptions.title: Frontend Engineer (React Specialist)
jobOptions.responsibilities: Focus on crafting highly responsive, accessible, and performant web interfaces, managing complex client-side state, and collaborating closely with UI/UX designers to translate designs into clean React code.
jobOptions.why: React is the leading frontend library globally. Your specialized knowledge allows you to dive deep into performance optimization, custom hooks, and modern state management.

jobOptions.title: Backend Engineer (Node.js Specialist)
jobOptions.responsibilities: Architect scalable server-side logic, design secure APIs, manage database connections, handle authentication, and optimize server-side performance and resource consumption.
jobOptions.why: Node.js is highly efficient for I/O-heavy applications. Utilizing JavaScript on the backend allows you to leverage asynchronous programming patterns to build fast and scalable APIs.

skills.title: TypeScript
skills.why: TypeScript adds static typing to JavaScript, significantly reducing runtime errors, improving code readability, and enhancing the developer experience in both React and Node.js environments.
skills.how: Convert an existing React or Node project from JavaScript to TypeScript, or start a new full-stack project using tools like Vite (for React) and ts-node.

skills.title: PostgreSQL & MongoDB
skills.why: A full-stack developer must understand how to store and query data. Learning both a Relational (PostgreSQL) and Non-Relational (MongoDB) database gives you flexibility for different project requirements.
skills.how: Integrate PostgreSQL into a Node.js API using an ORM like Prisma, and learn how to write raw SQL queries alongside schema migrations.

skills.title: Docker & AWS (or Render/Vercel)
skills.why: To move beyond local development, you need to understand how applications are containerized, deployed, scaled, and monitored in production environments.
skills.how: Write a Dockerfile for your Node backend and React frontend, and deploy them using services like Render, Vercel, or AWS ECS.

learningApproach.title: How to Approach Learning
points: Build Project-Based Portfolios: Create a complex, real-world full-stack application (e.g., an e-commerce platform or a real-time chat app) to synthesize React and Node.
Master Asynchronous Programming: Deepen your understanding of event loops, promises, and async/await in JavaScript, as this is crucial for Node.js performance.
Understand System Design: Move beyond syntax and start learning architectural patterns, such as MVC, microservices, and clean architecture, to design scalable systems.
